releaseNotes:
v0.2.12

- Fix transferred slideshow videos rendering as a black screen. Files picked
  from a content:// URI (SAF / MediaStore) were copied without their .mp4
  extension, so the slideshow misclassified the video as an image. Now the
  real filename + extension is preserved (DISPLAY_NAME, with a MIME-type
  fallback).

Note: a slideshow video added before this build was saved without an
extension — remove and re-pick it after updating. No re-transfer needed.
